method: Select 256 OD cells by residual nullspace leverage, conditioned on previously selected cells. With exact equality on the probes and on OD totals in 32 contiguous origin groups crossed with 32 contiguous destination groups, compute the minimum and maximum signed contrast between the same two near-optimal witness sets. The contrast is the sign of the pooled train/validation prior component in the count, margin and span nullspace. No random draws.
